coverage.reason: Ihold (2.00A), Itrip (4.00A), Vmax (6 VDC), Imax (35A), Pd typ (0.8W), time-to-trip (1.00s at 8.00A), Rimin (0.015 ohm), and R1max (0.07 ohm) are all primary-source confirmed from the RUILON SMD1210 Series Performance Specification table, row SMD1210P200TF.

Ambient operating range (-40 to +85C), maximum tripped-state surface temperature (125C), 85C-ambient derated hold current (0.98A), and qualitative aging/thermal-shock/repeated-trip resistance-change data are all primary-source confirmed from the same datasheet's Environmental Specifications and Thermal Derating Chart-Ih(A) tables.

Ihold leaves a 0.8A margin above the +12V/1.2A rail current budget (safe), but Vmax leaves a -6V margin against the +12V nominal rail voltage: the part's own 6V maximum voltage rating is exceeded by the rail it protects under normal, non-fault operation. This resolves the project's previously-unconfirmed PTC1 voltage-rating data gap with a deterministic spec violation rather than a passing margin.

No board-b generator spec exists yet to bound upstream fault current/energy at PTC1, in-enclosure ambient temperature, local heat sources, expected trip count over product life, or the cooling interval between faults.
